_readme: Canonical GE Beauty category taxonomy + per-marketplace crosswalk. See gebeauty/b2b/marketplace-registry-field-mapping.md decision #1: build ONE canonical tree + a thin crosswalk per marketplace, so a new marketplace only needs a new crosswalk column, not a rebuild. `null` values are genuinely unresolved — confirmed against the live registry spreadsheets read 2026-08, not guessed. Owner for filling `null`s: Lucas/growth per marketplace onboarding.

amazon._note: product_type = the Amazon Seller Central flat-file sheet/category (confirmed by reading the live templates, apps.md: Amazon field mapping). browse_node numeric IDs are NOT resolved — Amazon's browse taxonomy is opaque numeric IDs with no existing mapping table; flagged in the field-mapping doc as needing Lucas/comprador ownership. Do not guess these.

blz._note: Categoria enum confirmed from the live template's 'Aux - Listas Suspensas' sheet: BZ1-Maquiagem, BZ2-Cabelos, BZ3-Skin Care, BZ4-Corpo e Banho, BZ5-Perfumes.
blz._body_hair_mist_note: Ambiguous between BZ2-Cabelos (haircare positioning) and BZ5-Perfumes (fragrance-forward product) — needs Lucas's call, not guessed.

sephora._note: Sephora's 'Categoria' field is free text, not a closed enum. gebeauty/b2b/sephora/sephora_mapper.py already defaults every haircare SKU (including body & hair mist, per its own comment 'ainda haircare at Sephora') to CABELO.

rappi._note: Neither Turbo's 'Categoria' nor E-commerce's category1-3 have a confirmed finer taxonomy — only the generic 'Cosméticos' value was observed in the filled samples, and category1-3 was never populated in the one E-commerce sample available. Genuinely unresolved; needs Lucas/growth to confirm with Rappi's actual requirement docs before filling.
